sections.en: We have already warned above that it was copied. Mr. Bassi of Milan kindly sent us a copy. And that these things were mixed into Palchus's little work much later is sufficiently and more than sufficiently clear from the thoroughly vulgar language, nor are other traces of the time lacking, such as the Turks named on p. 181, 25. Therefore we have not even received Palchus complete in the Angelicus codex; concerning which matter cf. Catal., VI, p. 63, n. 1; Cumont and Stroobant, Bull. Acad. Belgique, 1903, p. 573 f. — On the tutelages of the planets, cf. Roscher in Lexico mytholog. s. v. Planetae. — Moreover, this very chapter seems not to be complete: for to Venus, Mars, Saturn, Jupiter, Mercury, Moon, Sun in the third place is added the Ascending Node or Head of the Dragon, but the Tail of the Dragon is now indeed missing, which would complete the number of nine planets customary for the Arabs and Indians. F. B.

summary.headline: Planetary Properties by Remainder
summary.text: Astrological method for identifying foods, plants, animals, metals, stones, and other substances by counting from the face of the horoscoping sign to its lord modulo eight. One remainder signifies Venus and two Mars, with associated colors, shapes, qualities, tastes, habitats, and products; three signifies the Ascending Node or Head of the Dragon, with saffron color, square shape, and listed materials.
